subject: food-technology
title: Balanced Meals
welcome_lead: Plate maths: getting the proportions right.
meta_desc: KS3 food: balanced meals and portion sizes.
final_note: A balanced meal mixes the food groups.

concepts.def: Right amounts of each food group.
Amount you serve to one person.

walkthroughs.body_html: A balanced meal contains some carbs, some protein, plenty of veg and a little fat. Skipping any group = missing some nutrients.
Use your hand to judge: palm of protein, fist of carbs, two handfuls of veg, thumb of fat. Works at any age, in any country.
If you eat the same energy you use, weight stays steady. Eat more = gain. Less = lose. Active kids need around 2000-2400 calories a day.
